title: Notification of state law limitation on tenant screening fees
requirement: Owners must provide a clear and conspicuous tenant screening fee rights statement and maximum fee cap statement in the rental application or separate disclosure before receiving a screening fee.

title: Prohibition of non-refundable application fees associated with existing tenancies
requirement: An owner or agent cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for renewing a tenancy, departing a roommate, or adding/replacing a roommate.
quoted_span: An owner of residential rental property (or the owner’s agent) cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for the purpose of renewing a tenancy, in whole or in part, including any fee associated with the departure of a roommate or to request to add or replace a roommate in a pre-existing household.

title: Applicability to Existing Rental Agreements
requirement: Chapter 13.78 applies to all residential rental agreements regardless of contrary lease language, and conflicting lease provisions are unenforceable.
quoted_span: Chapter 13.78 applies to all residential rental agreements regardless of any contractual language in any rental agreement or lease to the contrary.
